# Synapse 2.0.13

Workflows Synapse AI builds now run the first time in three more cases, an agent built for one of an import's agents keeps that agent's instructions exactly, and Home tells you when it is still loading or could not load.

## Fixed

- **A workflow you ask to start from a form now starts from one.** Asking for something like "someone submits an expense on a form" could build a first step that never showed a form, so every run stopped. Synapse AI now builds the form as the workflow's first step, and the plan says the workflow starts when someone fills it in.
- **A step after a branch no longer stops every run.** When a workflow split into branches and a single step after the split saved the result, it could read something only one branch writes, and the runs that took another branch stopped. Synapse AI now has every branch hand over the same result, or does the step in each branch.
- **A loop goes through the list it was meant to.** A loop over a step's whole answer, instead of the list inside it, ran zero times and the run said Completed while later steps worked on nothing. Synapse AI now points the loop at the list and says so on the plan. A loop given something that is not a list stops with a plain message naming the list to use, instead of reporting success. A loop over something a branch never set still runs zero times, and says why.
- **An agent built for one of your import's agents keeps that agent's instructions exactly.** When Synapse AI turned an OpenAI Agent Builder or Agents SDK export into agents, it could rewrite an agent's instructions in its own words. Each agent built to stand for one of the export's agents now keeps that agent's instructions exactly. An agent that stands for none of them keeps the instructions Synapse AI wrote for it. An agent you already had keeps its own instructions, and the plan tells you so you can check.
- **Synapse AI no longer asks about words inside your import.** Words like "recent" in an imported agent's instructions no longer start a question about which days you mean. A time period you write yourself above the export is still asked about. Values an imported agent reads, like `${topic}`, now read as "the topic (given in the message)" instead of the same words for each.
- **Home tells you when it is still loading or could not load.** While Home waits for the server, each section says it is loading. If the server does not answer within 15 seconds, the section says it could not load, with **Try again**, instead of staying empty.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.13`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.

**Full changelog:** [v2.0.12...v2.0.13](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/compare/v2.0.12...v2.0.13) · [Documentation](https://docs.synapseorch.com)
